slots.claim_sentence: Many decisions arise from the accumulation of noisy evidence until a threshold is reached.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process is known as bounded evidence accumulation.

slots.claim_sentence: The bounded evidence accumulation theory predicts that more noise leads to faster decisions.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also predicts reduced accuracy and, paradoxically, higher confidence.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a novel sensory manipulation to mimic unbiased noise in visual cortex regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neuronal recordings in macaque areas MT/MST verified this manipulation.

slots.claim_sentence: In humans and monkeys, increased noise led to faster decisions and greater confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: Accuracy was only minimally impaired by the increased noise.

slots.claim_sentence: The observed effects of increased noise were consistent with predictions of a bounded evidence accumulation model.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model explains how volatility influences choice, reaction time, and confidence.

slots.claim_sentence: The granular retrosplenial cortex (RSG) is important for both spatial and non-spatial behaviors.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, how the RSG processes information is not well understood.

slots.claim_sentence: This study used optogenetic circuit mapping in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method revealed parallel circuits in the superficial RSG that process different inputs.

slots.claim_sentence: The anterior thalamus and dorsal subiculum provide spatial information.
slots.clarification_sentence: These areas strongly activate low-rheobase (LR) pyramidal cells in the RSG.

slots.claim_sentence: Regular-spiking (RS) cells are located near LR cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Inputs from the claustrum and anterior cingulate primarily control RS cells, conveying mostly non-spatial information.

slots.claim_sentence: The precise arrangement of axons and dendrites within layer 1 of the RSG enables this parallel processing.
slots.clarification_sentence: This organization allows for the integration of incoming spatial information.

slots.claim_sentence: Thalamocortical synaptic dynamics allow computational models of LR neurons to calculate head rotation speed.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs even though their inputs only provide head direction, not speed. These dynamics enable robust encoding of angular speed.

slots.claim_sentence: Parallel input streams identify LR neurons as a distinct neuronal subtype.
slots.clarification_sentence: These neurons are ideally positioned to support spatial orientation computations in the RSG.

slots.claim_sentence: Arabidopsis thaliana flowers consistently have four petals.
slots.clarification_sentence: This consistent petal number is an invariant and robust trait.

slots.claim_sentence: The closely related species Cardamine hirsuta exhibits variation in petal number.
slots.clarification_sentence: The genetic basis for this difference in petal number between species was unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: Divergence in the floral regulator APETALA1 (AP1) explains the species-specific difference in petal number robustness.
slots.clarification_sentence: AP1 is a gene that helps control how petals form.

slots.claim_sentence: Arabidopsis thaliana APETALA1 (AP1) confers robustness by masking the phenotypic expression of quantitative trait loci (QTL).
slots.clarification_sentence: These QTL control petal number in Cardamine hirsuta.

slots.claim_sentence: Petal number was effectively canalized in Cardamine hirsuta via epistasis of Arabidopsis thaliana AP1.
Cardamine hirsuta APETALA1 (AP1) fails to complement the function of Arabidopsis thaliana AP1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This failure leads to variable petal number in Cardamine hirsuta.

slots.claim_sentence: Upstream regulatory regions of AP1 contribute to this divergence between the two species.
slots.clarification_sentence: Functional differences in AP1 reside in these regulatory regions.

slots.claim_sentence: Variable petal number persists in Cardamine hirsuta.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs despite sufficient genetic variation in natural populations to produce four-petalled flowers.

slots.claim_sentence: MicroRNAs, or miRNAs, are noncoding RNAs that regulate gene expression after transcription.
slots.clarification_sentence: miR-9 is one of the most abundant miRNAs found in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: The function of miR-9 in neural progenitors is known.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, its role in dendritic and synaptic development was largely unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a transgenic miRNA sponge mouse line to study miR-9 in living organisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This line allows for conditional and spatio-temporally controlled inactivation of the miR-9 family.

slots.claim_sentence: This new approach showed that miR-9 controls dendritic growth in living organisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: miR-9 also controls synaptic transmission in living organisms.

slots.claim_sentence: miR-9-mediated downregulation of the transcriptional repressor REST is essential for proper dendritic growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: miR-9 regulates the expression of the transcriptional repressor REST.

slots.claim_sentence: The behavioral correlates of motor cortical beta oscillations are not fully understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Motor cortical beta oscillations are a type of brain wave in the motor system that controls movement.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers recorded multi-scale neural activity from the motor cortex of three macaques.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done to investigate the link between population neural activity, beta oscillations, and behavior using a neurofeedback task.

slots.claim_sentence: The macaques intentionally increased or decreased their beta oscillatory power to a specific level.
slots.clarification_sentence: After controlling their beta power, the macaques then performed an arm reach.

slots.claim_sentence: Arm reaches were initiated significantly faster when beta power was previously reduced.
slots.clarification_sentence: Movement onset times were slower when beta power had been increased.

slots.claim_sentence: Population neural activity shifted farther from a movement onset state during beta oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shift occurred whether beta oscillations were induced by neurofeedback or happened naturally. A movement onset state refers to specific neural activity patterns before movement begins.

slots.claim_sentence: When neurons generated beta oscillations, their patterns were further from the movement onset threshold.
This research provides a neural explanation for slower movement initiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This explanation is at the population level and follows periods of beta oscillatory activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The impact of Nrf2 activation on human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection had not been tested.
Sulforaphane (SFN) is found in cruciferous vegetables.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN mobilizes Nrf2 to reprogram cellular gene expression. SFN is a powerful mobilizer of the transcription factor Nrf2.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN blocks HIV infection in primary macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN does not block HIV infection in primary T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Depletion of Nrf2 boosted HIV infectivity in primary macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: This depletion reduced the anti-viral effects of SFN treatment. Nrf2 is detrimental to HIV infection in macrophages.

slots.claim_sentence: The anti-viral activity of SFN against HIV is mediated through Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 is mobilized by SFN. SFN acts to block HIV by increasing Nrf2 levels.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN treatment blocks HIV infection after entry.
slots.clarification_sentence: This block occurs before the formation of 2-LTR circles. SFN stops HIV infection after reverse transcription.

slots.claim_sentence: Neither SAMHD1 nor MX2 were upregulated by SFN treatment.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN did not significantly change levels of either SAMHD1 or MX2.

slots.claim_sentence: Nrf2 action can potently block HIV infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This study highlights a novel way to trigger this inhibition. SFN provides a new way to activate an anti-viral state.

slots.claim_sentence: Under nitrogen deprivation, Anabaena filaments develop into a pattern of nitrogen-fixing heterocysts separated by photosynthetic vegetative cells.
The coupling of gene expression fluctuations between cells along a multicellular filament in Anabaena was unknown.
The study investigated HetR gene expression fluctuations, a transcription factor essential for heterocyst differentiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used a chromosomally-encoded translational hetR-gfp fusion to track HetR expression. This fusion tests expression of the gene with all its transcription and translation start signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Expression fluctuations of hetR in nearby Anabaena cells are coupled.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling has a characteristic spatial range of about two to three cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Correlations between cells predominantly arise from intercellular molecular transfer.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cell division contributes less to these correlations.

slots.claim_sentence: Fluctuations in hetR expression after nitrogen step-down can build up on those under nitrogen-replete conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests continuity between fluctuations under different nitrogen conditions.

slots.claim_sentence: Under nitrogen-rich conditions, the HetR inhibitor PatS is an essential determinant of hetR expression fluctuations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cell-cell communication influenced by septal protein SepJ and positive HetR auto-regulation also determine these fluctuations.

slots.claim_sentence: Proteins involved in activation, inhibition, and cell-cell communication control coupled fluctuations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These fluctuations, combined with stochasticity in gene expression, lead to a one-dimensional developmental pattern in Anabaena.

slots.claim_sentence: Little is known about how associative learning between a cue and a required visuomotor mapping generalizes to novel but similar conditions.
Participants performed a rapid target-pointing task where the offset between visual feedback and movement end-points was manipulated.
The visual feedback had horizontal offsets that varied based on the target's shape.
The target shapes were part of a continuous set, morphed between spiky and circular forms.
After training, participants' performance was tested on novel target shapes, without feedback.
Learning the associations required explicit awareness of the cues' role.
slots.clarification_sentence: Participants applied the visuomotor mapping of the trained shape most similar to the current one, consistent with the Bayesian learning model.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian learning model predicted that learning would slow down with more training pairs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This prediction was confirmed by the experimental results.

slots.claim_sentence: The good correspondence between the Bayesian learning model and empirical results suggests it provides a possible mechanism for simultaneously learning multiple visuomotor mappings.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model indicates that participants learn separate shape-response pairs rather than their relationship.

slots.claim_sentence: Many countries where neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are common cannot start or expand programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These countries lack basic data for planning and advocacy.

slots.claim_sentence: An integrated mapping approach for NTDs could save significant resources.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is true where these diseases geographically overlap.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed and field-tested an innovative integrated NTD mapping protocol.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protocol is called Integrated Threshold Mapping (ITM) Methodology.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM protocol determines if a disease threshold has been reached in an implementation unit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This threshold triggers public health interventions.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers tested the ITM protocol by comparing it to current World Health Organization (WHO) mapping methodologies.
slots.clarification_sentence: The comparison took place in one district each in Mali and Senegal.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as WHO methodologies for trachoma, lymphatic filariasis (LF), and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).
slots.clarification_sentence: These conclusions were about initiating public health interventions.

slots.claim_sentence: ITM resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis.
The ITM methodology was practical, feasible, and demonstrated overall cost savings.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was compared to standard, non-integrated WHO methodologies.

slots.claim_sentence: This integrated mapping tool could help implement much-needed NTD programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These programs are for countries where NTDs are common.

slots.claim_sentence: Staphylococcus aureus expresses cell wall-anchored proteins that mediate adhesion, invasion, and immune evasion.

slots.claim_sentence: Clumping factor B (ClfB) is a cell wall-anchored protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: ClfB facilitates S. aureus nasal colonization by interacting with the cornified envelope.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of ClfB during skin and soft tissue infection (SSTI) had not been investigated.
This study reveals a novel role for ClfB during S. aureus SSTIs.
ClfB is crucial for determining the abscess structure and bacterial burden early in infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is dependent upon a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin.

slots.claim_sentence: Targeting ClfB with a model vaccine led to protection during S. aureus skin infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The vaccine induced both protective humoral and cellular responses.

slots.claim_sentence: This study identifies ClfB as an important antigen for future SSTI vaccines.

The role of ClfB during skin and soft tissue infection (SSTI) had not been investigated. This study reveals a novel role for ClfB during S. aureus SSTIs. ClfB is crucial for determining the abscess structure and bacterial burden early in infection. This is dependent upon a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin. Targeting ClfB with a model vaccine led to protection during S. aureus skin infection. The vaccine induced both protective humoral and cellular responses. This study identifies ClfB as an important antigen for future SSTI vaccines.
